32798f0.summary: AI scoring helper: how valuable it is for the AI to deal the given damage to a unit. Returns a flat score for special traits (ambush, long range, drop pod), otherwise scales the unit's value in play by how much of it the hit removes (or most of it if lethal), then adds the card's extra damaging/killing scores. Used by ScoreFromCriteria.
comments: Empty CardEffect: this variant has no buff, so its healthChange is 0
Ambush units get a flat high score of 10, so the AI is drawn to hitting them
Bastion counts as extra effective health
Invulnerable units cannot be hurt: score stays at -10
Max health of 0 or less would divide by zero: log an error and score 0
Dodge or shield may negate the hit: score is melee attack / 3 plus 1
Long range units get a flat score of 3
Drop pod units (not yet landed) get a flat low score of 0.5
Vulnerable adds to damage taken, unless this damage type already counts as vulnerable damage
Copy the anti-cheat wrapped health into locals to read the real current health
Minion: score depends on whether the hit kills it
Non-lethal: 60% of value in play, scaled by the share of max health removed
Lethal: 80% of value in play if the unit has survivor, otherwise the full value
Hero (warlord): per-damage score, higher (1.8 vs 1.2) when it would be left under 16 health
Lethal on a hero is worth a huge 1e6 (wins the game)
Add the card's own extra score for being damaged; if the hit is lethal also add the kill bonus
Shared tail for the dodge/shield branch: add the extra score

Copy the anti-cheat wrapped health into locals to read the real current health
Minion: score depends on whether the hit kills it

Lethal: 80% of value in play if the unit has survivor, otherwise the full value
Hero (warlord): per-damage score, higher (1.8 vs 1.2) when it would be left under 16 health
Lethal on a hero is worth a huge 1e6 (wins the game)
Add the card's own extra score for being damaged; if the hit is lethal also add the kill bonus

3279964.summary: AI scoring helper: how valuable it is to heal a unit by the given amount. The heal is capped at the damage the unit actually has; heroes score double when below 11 health, minions score by their value in play per share of max health healed.
comments: Only damage actually missing can be healed: cap the heal at the unit's current damage
Nothing to heal means a score of 0
Hero: 1 point per health healed, doubled when the hero is at 10 health or less
Copy the anti-cheat wrapped health into locals to read the real current health
Minion: value in play scaled by the fraction of max health restored
Max health of 0 or less would divide by zero: log an error and score 0
Add the card's own extra score for being healed

3279ac4.summary: AI scoring helper: finds the best attack score a card could get among all attacks it could make with the given buffs. Called while scoring buff effects (see ScoreFromCriteria option 5).
comments: Build the list of attacks the card could make under the acting buff
Try each potential attack and remember the best score (starting at 0)
Score the attack as if both the attacker and the target had their buffs

32797cc.summary: AI scoring helper: how valuable it is to poison a target. Returns 0 for targets already poisoned, resistant or a warlord; otherwise a fraction of the target's value in play, higher if it is stunned, lower if it will die soon.
comments: Already poisoned: nothing to gain
Resistant units ignore poison
Warlords cannot be poisoned (or the AI does not try)
Not stunned: check the other cases; stunned targets use 0.8 below

327a170.summary: AI scoring helper: how valuable it is to return a card to its owner's hand. Combines the card's cost with the drop in value versus its reference value, and reduces the score for cards with rally or codex traits.
comments: Reference value in play: what the card would be worth as a fresh copy
Check whether the card has the rally trait (worth 2)
Check whether the card has the codex trait (worth another 2)
Cost plus 1.5 times the value lost by returning it, minus the trait bonus

327a218.summary: AI scoring helper: how valuable it is to give a card charge. If it cannot act now because of summoning sickness, the score is its melee attack; otherwise 0.

Energy that would be available after the cost change is applied
If the result exceeds the total Energy for the turn, the buff is worth nothing
Cards in hand of the card's owner
Count hand cards not affordable now that become affordable after the buff

327a4dc.summary: AI scoring helper for effects that buff cards in hand. Splits the targets into friendly and enemy hands, finds the best card that becomes newly playable with the cost change, penalises cards that were already playable, then scales by the number of affected cards. Decompiler output for the list handling is messy.

327a950.summary: AI scoring helper: how valuable it is to draw a card. If the deck is empty the score is a negative based on the fatigue counter; otherwise the given score adjusted by the room left in the hand.

Empty deck: drawing costs fatigue damage, so the score is -2 minus fatigue
Deck not empty: given score plus the spare hand slots (max - hand - 1)

327aba4.summary: AI scoring helper: how valuable it is to keep a card in hand rather than play it. Returns the card's extra keep score times a bonus from the turn number (early turns) and the hand size (small hands).
comments: Read the current turn counter (anti-cheat wrapped)
Early game (turn 10 or lower): bonus grows with the turn number, wrapping at 10
Later turns give no turn bonus
Use the hand of the side that owns the card
Number of cards in hand

3277f0c.summary: Main AI scoring function for one ScoringCriteria on a card (with optional target). Starts from a base value for friend or enemy target, counts targets to get a multiplier, then switches on the scoring option (damage, heal, buffs, draw, stun, poison and more) and adds weighted per-target scores. Returns the total.
comments: No criteria means no score
Codex effect: only score it if the card can be played with codex now
Cannot be played with codex: log it and score 0
Base value depends on whether the target is on the same side as the card (friend) or not (enemy)
Multiplier: 1 for any target, otherwise the number of targets matching the multiplier criteria
Get the cards the criteria would affect
Switch on the scoring option; most cases sum a friend/enemy weight times a per-target score
Option 1: count matching friendly and enemy targets with two filters and weight each count
Option 2: weight by each target's value in play
Offsets 0x1c and 0x18 are multiplyByEnemy and multiplyByFriend (decompiler shows raw offsets)
Option 3: damage; use average damage and score hurting each target
Option 4: heal; use average heal value and score healing each target
Option 5: attack buff; best attack score with the buff minus without it, for units that can act
Option 6: weight by each target's current melee attack
Option 7: jam score of each target
Option 8: random score from 0 to 100
Option 9: base friend value only if the number of targets exceeds the enemy base value
Option 10: base friend value only if the number of targets is below the enemy base value
Option 11 (0xb): buff score of each target
Option 12 (0xc): buff to cards in hand
Option 13 (0xd): Energy cost buff
Option 14 (0xe): stun score of each target
Option 20 (0x14): poison score of each target
Option 25 (0x19): return-to-hand score of each target
Option 30 (0x1e): charge score of each target
Option 35 (0x23): draw card score for the acting card's owner
Option 40 (0x28): add the weight for each target whose card data has max health 0
Return the accumulated score
